subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1: New Media – Introducing New Media
outcomes: Name different types of devices and media.
Explain what 'new media' means in my own words.
Listen for key words to find out which media a speaker describes.

tf.s: New media are types of media that are interactive.
tf.why: Yes! New media let people take part and communicate.

tf.s: A printed newspaper is a good example of new media.
tf.why: A printed newspaper is old media; it is one-way communication.

tf.s: A blog lets readers comment and communicate with the writer.
tf.why: Right, that is why a blog is interactive new media.

tf.s: An online news site is a digital version of a newspaper.
tf.why: Correct, it is the newspaper on the Internet.

tf.s: A smartphone, a tablet and a computer are all examples of a device.
tf.why: Well done, these are all devices.

tf.s: All radios need batteries to work.
tf.why: Some radios run on solar power or wind up, so they do not need batteries.

tf.s: On social media you can connect with other people and scroll through posts.
tf.why: Yes, these are key things people do on social media.

tf.s: A video game is a type of old media.
tf.why: A video game is interactive, so it belongs to new media.

tf.s: The first speaker says the radio cannot reach people in the desert.
tf.why: The speaker says the radio reaches everyone, even in the desert.

boxes.q: Which device can run on solar power or wind up?
boxes.why: Some radios use solar power or wind up instead of batteries.
Interactive media let people communicate with each other.
A blog is online and interactive.

boxes.q: Which word completes: 'Social media helps people ___ with friends'?
boxes.why: We communicate with friends on social media.

boxes.q: What is an online news site?
o: a digital version of a newspaper
boxes.why: It gives the news on the Internet.

boxes.q: Which of these is worn on your wrist?
boxes.why: A smart watch is a small device you wear on your wrist.

boxes.q: Which is a type of old media?
boxes.why: Radio is a traditional, one-way medium.

boxes.q: What can you do on social media?
boxes.why: Scrolling through posts is a typical social media activity.

boxes.q: Which word describes a smartphone, a tablet or a computer?
Why can the radio be more important than TV, says speaker 1?
boxes.why: The radio reaches rich and poor people, in cities and in the desert.

hunt.q: Media you read online, written by one person
A device you wear like a watch
You play it on a screen
New media let people do this
Media you can hear but not see
Printed news you buy every day

mcq.q: New media are types of media that are ...
mcq.why: New media let people take part and communicate.

mcq.q: Which of these is a device?
mcq.why: A tablet is a device, like a smartphone or a computer.

mcq.q: Which is a type of media that you can read on paper?
Which word means 'to join or link with other people'?
mcq.why: We connect with other people, for example on social media.

mcq.q: A speaker says: 'It uses solar power, so you don't need batteries.' What is it?
mcq.why: The key words 'solar power' and 'batteries' point to the radio.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence about media.
o: I use social media because I can talk to my friends.
I use social media because it is printed.
I read a radio every morning.
I listen to a magazine at night.
mcq.why: This sentence uses the media word correctly and gives a reason.

mcq.q: Ali reads the news on his phone and writes comments. What is he using?
mcq.why: Reading news online and commenting is new, interactive media.

mcq.q: Why is a blog new media but a printed newspaper is not?
o: A blog lets readers comment and communicate.
A blog is only for news.
mcq.why: A blog is interactive, while a printed newspaper is one-way.

mcq.q: Which words tell you a speaker is talking about social media?
o: connect with people, scroll through posts
mcq.why: Connecting and scrolling through posts describe social media.

mcq.q: Which group has only new media?
mcq.why: Blogs, social media and video games are all interactive.
